full_prompt_en: A square sepia-toned mixed-media portrait resembles an old studio photograph of four girls standing in a row against a worn, mottled wall. The girls wear long, modest dresses in pale cream and dark brown, with collars and full skirts reaching below the knees. The youngest-looking figures occupy the center, while taller girls anchor the left and right sides. Their faces are still and unsmiling, and the black-and-white photographic detail is softened by age and grain. Behind them stands an older woman in a dark coat, visible from the waist up and partly shielded by a black open umbrella whose curved canopy spans the upper center. A large horned animal skull appears beneath the umbrella above the children, its pale bone and dark eye cavities turning the familiar portrait into a strange tableau. At the bottom center, another ram-like skull with curling horns rests on the floor in front of the row. The figures' black shoes meet a rough dark ground, and the empty wall around them has stains, scratches, and faded borders. Light is broad and frontal, like an old studio exposure, leaving soft shadows beneath the hats, umbrella, and dresses rather than a sharply directional beam. The subdued palette of gray, brown, and ivory keeps all elements within one aged surface, so the surreal additions feel embedded in the photograph. Vertical human figures and the two pale skull forms establish a deliberate central stack. The overall composition is formal and eerie, balancing historical portrait stillness with an unsettling symbolic interruption.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形棕褐色混合媒介肖像酷似旧影棚照片：四个女孩并排站在斑驳磨损的墙前。她们穿长而朴素的连衣裙，颜色有浅奶油色与深棕色，带领口，宽裙摆垂至膝下。看似年纪较小的女孩位于中央，较高者稳住左右两边。面孔静止而不带笑意，黑白摄影细节被年代与颗粒柔化。她们身后站着一位深外套成年女子，上半身可见，部分被一把敞开的黑伞遮住，弯曲伞面横跨上方中央。一颗带角动物头骨出现在伞下、孩子们头顶，浅色骨面与深色眼窝让熟悉的合影变得奇异。下方中央，另一颗卷角羊类头骨置于这一排人物前的地面上。她们的黑鞋接触粗糙暗地面，周围空墙有污迹、划痕和褪色边框。光线宽阔而正面，像旧式影棚曝光，只在帽子、伞和衣服下留下柔软阴影，而不是锋利的定向光。灰、棕、象牙色的低调配色把所有元素置于同一陈旧表面，使超现实添加物像嵌在照片里。竖立人物和两处浅色头骨形成有意的中央层叠。整体构图正式而诡异，把历史肖像的静止与令人不安的象征性打断平衡。
style_prompt_en: The image has the appearance of an aged photographic collage, with sepia gray, worn ivory, and deep brown fused by grain and surface abrasion. Formal front-facing alignment gives the scene the stiffness of an archival portrait, while unexpected inserted forms disturb that order without changing the even light. Fine scratches, faded borders, and mottled stains soften edges and unify otherwise separate elements. Pale shapes stand out from a dark vertical center, and the limited tonal range suppresses any modern gloss. Shadows remain soft and frontal, with depth conveyed by simple overlap rather than strong perspective. The overall effect is antique, composed, and quietly uncanny.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有旧摄影拼贴的外观，棕褐灰、磨旧象牙白和深棕色被颗粒与表面擦损融合。正式的正面排列带来档案肖像的僵定感，意外插入的形体在不改变均匀光线的情况下打乱秩序。细小划痕、褪色边界与斑驳污迹柔化边缘，也统一原本分离的元素。浅色形状从深色竖向中心突出，有限影调压制一切现代光泽。阴影柔软而偏正面，纵深由简单重叠而非强透视表达。整体效果陈旧、有安排感，又安静诡异。
theme_en: Four solemn girls beneath an umbrella with horned animal skulls
theme_zh: 四个神情严肃的女孩站在伞下，前后有带角动物头骨
name: Beth Conklin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
